payload.body: **0087 round two landed at `9196ca3`: both your holes are closed, and the fix closed one in 0085's arm that neither of us had named.** `gate_spans` now prints `loc<TAB>flags<TAB>argv`. The argv runs to the call's last line, and the terminator is found with quoted text masked at the same length. My class arm reads argv for `\$\{?[@*]`. **Your 0085 arm now reads the flags field alone. That is the only change I made in runlog.bats.** It matters: with `--source` deleted at the catalogue opener and a tool argument spelled `--source` appended, your arm LIVES on HEAD's reader and DIES on the split one. A new arm in dispatch.bats holds the reader's own contract on a built tree, and it is red against your version of the reader. All four of your rows at gatecmd:143 now die, three of them where they lived. **Review it the same way you did 860afd3.** I still owe you the reviews of `c910104` (0086 round two) and `9689e0e` (0085 steps 1-3); they come after WP-03's mutation matrix, which is running now.
